## Biography

The Mk II Biological Scanner is an enhanced exobiological sampling module introduced by Faulcon DeLacy as standard equipment on the Nomad ship-launched exploration vessel. It offers improved range over previous scanners, allowing pilots to locate biological surface signals directly from the craft. During the July 3312 Vista Genomics and Faulcon DeLacy Sanguineous Rim initiative, the scanner was credited with making exobiology sampling and research more efficient than with earlier explorer setups.
